description: 국가철도공단_코레일_유실물센터 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 데이터에는 철도운영기관명, 노선명, 역명 등의 기본 정보와 함께, 유실물센터가 지상 또는 지하 중 어디에 위치하는지, 몇 층에 설치되어 있는지에 대한 정보가 포함되어 있어 실제 위치. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 유실물, 지하철, 출입구번호, 이용가능시간. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
